correctness.rationale: For C_{3k}^k, k≥2, the clique dichotomy gives all consecutive-arc simplices plus exactly k exceptional triangles t_j={j,j+k,j+2k}. The arc subcomplex is a good circular-arc nerve ≃S¹; its canonical radial projection has degree 1 on the 3k-cycle. Every exceptional boundary winds once, so integral relative C_2=Z^k maps to H_1(S¹)=Z by summation. Thus H_2=ker(∑), H_1=0, and the usual CW argument gives a wedge of k−1 spheres. Rotation shifts t_j; reflection reverses their orientation and sends j→−j, giving exactly the signed permutation kernel and parity-sensitive traces. The attached enumerator checks k=2..8 as corroboration only.
